title: GTA V Wasted
blurb: Greyscale, slow motion, and one word across the screen. Rockstar's death sting from Grand Theft Auto V has a particular sting to it because the game slows time first, giving you a moment to fully appreciate the mistake before the thud arrives. The meme format essentially wrote itself: apply it to any real-world faceplant, rejection or comprehensive defeat, with the desaturation filter strongly implied. It remains the most cinematic way available to announce that somebody has just been folded by life. A fail-compilation essential since 2013.
origin: The death/arrest sting from Grand Theft Auto V (Rockstar, 2013).
